contract.task_clause:
Which of the following statements is true concerning the population regression function (PRF) and sample regression function (SRF)?
Option A: The PRF is the estimated model
Option B: The PRF is used to infer likely values of the SRF
Option C: Whether the model is good can be determined by comparing the SRF and the PRF
Option D: The PRF is a description of the process thought to be generating the data.
